Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_AirRaidSirenEvent_t: Choose true if you want an air raid event to signal a shift from less challenging early-game events to more hostile late-game events.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventJets_tooltip:
How frequent jet events occur.
Jets fly by players causing horde movement.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventNews_tooltip:
How frequent news events occur.
News choppers will hone in on any citizen they find and follow them around for a short time.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventPolice_tooltip:
How frequent police events occur.
The police will take matters into their own hands and escort citizens around while firing on zombies.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventMilitaryNonHos:
How frequent non-hostile military events occur.
The military will progress through stages: warn citizens, purge the undead, then ultimately purge anything that moves.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventMilitaryHostil:
How frequent hostile military events occur.
The military will progress through stages: warn citizens, purge the undead, then ultimately purge anything that moves.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventResupply_toolt:
How frequent late-game resupply flights occur.
What remains of the government keeps holdouts alive with cargo plane drops of food, seeds, tools and building materials. Occurs later in the apocalypse.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventSurvivor_toolt:
How frequent survivor events occur.
Survivors will occasionally fly around scouting for supplies. Occurs later in the apocalypse.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventDeserter_toolt:
How frequent deserter events occur.
Remnant army deserters will search for supplies and hone in on survivors for some entertainment. Occurs later in the apocalypse.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventSamaritan_tool:
How frequent mysterious stranger events occur.
Mysterious strangers will linger in the area and resupply their scouts. Occurs later in the apocalypse.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_StartDay_tooltip: This is what day into the game events occur. You will need to factor in
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_SchedulerDuration_t:
How many days the scheduler will run from the start day.
The scheduler will adjust event progression to fit this duration.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_ContinueSchedulingE:
Normally the scheduler ends at the duration limit, toggling this on continues to schedule events beyond the duration.
Events will still progress through stages according to the duration but events will never stop being scheduled.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_WeatherImpactsEvent: Whether weather will prevent events, or cause their crash.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_CrashChanceMulti_to: This is multiplied against crash chance, 0 will prevent crashes all together.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_EventMarkerPersiste: Real-time minutes crash and supply drop markers remain after the event. Markers are removed early once a player reaches the site. 0 keeps markers until reached.
Sandbox_ExpandedHeli_WorldStories_toolti:
How many sites of past helicopter activity are hidden around the map when the world is first loaded.
Includes old crashes, supply drops, scattered flyers, and abandoned helicopters with their crew's camp or the aftermath of a fight. 0 disables.
